messages:
emma (oncall): Pager alert — genqueue-eu-west-1: 5xx spike, automated circuit breakers tripped. paging emma.
incident-bot: [PAGER] genqueue-eu-west-1 — P1 — 5xx spike — triggered at 2026-03-17T14:06:39Z — oncall: emma
emma (oncall): Ack. I'm looking.
raj (sre): I'm on logs. Seeing repeated OOMs on gpu-3, pod restarts. autoscaler did not add nodes.
kyle (eng-runtime): Noted. Rolling fallback to quantized-variant v2 to reduce mem pressure, enabling burst pool for genqueue.
olivia (prod-commms): I'll draft a short status page entry. Initial copy:```We are investigating higher-than-normal error rates for text generation in EU-West (eu-west-1). Some requests may fail with 5xx errors. Our on-call team is investigating and mitigation work is underway.```
lisa (legal): Quick check — fine to say "no customer data exposed" if confirmed. Please confirm before public copy.
raj (sre): Confirmed no data exfil logs. Errors are internal mem pressure.
emma (oncall): OK olivia — add "no customer data impacted". Add ETA for next update in 15 min. I'll keep pager.
olivia (prod-commms): Updated draft:```Initial — 14:06 UTC — We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation in EU-West (eu-west-1). Some requests may fail with 5xx responses. Mitigation is in progress; no customer data is believed to be impacted. Next update in ~15 minutes.```
emma (oncall): Who can hit the publish button? Need ops approval.
kyle (eng-runtime): I can publish if legal signs off.
lisa (legal): OK from legal to publish this wording.
olivia (prod-commms): Publishing now. :rocket:
incident-bot: [STATUSPAGE] Published initial incident: "Elevated error rates — EU-West" — incident id inc_20260317_001
raj (sre): Mitigation: scaled genqueue pool + rolled fallback model to quantized variant on 4 hosts. Error rate down to ~12% (was ~48%). Continuing monitoring.
emma (oncall): Periodic update for status page:```14:25 UTC — Mitigation applied: autoscaler manual trigger + fallback model rolled. Error rate reduced to ~12%. Serving capacity increased; requests are still experiencing higher latency. Teams continue to monitor.```
olivia (prod-commms): Posted update 2.
support-bot: Sending customer-facing email snippet for impacted accounts:```We are investigating intermittent errors affecting text generation in EU-West. Mitigations have reduced errors; we will follow up when fully resolved.```
raj (sre): Follow-up: error rate trending toward normal; some pods still OOM'ing due to cache pressure. Patching autoscaler condition and pushing config now.
kyle (eng-runtime): Patch deployed to autoscaler, will observe for a full cycle.
emma (oncall): Observability shows error rate at 1.8% now. Systems stable for 10 minutes.
olivia (prod-commms): Draft resolved notice:```Resolved — 14:50 UTC — The issue causing elevated error rates in EU-West has been resolved. Root cause: autoscaler race condition interacting with model KV cache eviction, causing OOMs and pod restarts. Fixes: autoscaler condition hardened and fallback model rollout completed. No customer data was exposed. We apologize for the interruption.```
lisa (legal): LGTM.
emma (oncall): Marking incident resolved. Please post final and send customer emails.
olivia (prod-commms): Posted resolved notice and queued customer notifications. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] inc_20260317_001 — marked resolved at 1718251200
emma (oncall): Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short RCA doc later.
raj (sre): I'll create RCA with timelines and config diff.
kyle (eng-runtime): Also adding a test to the autoscaler CI for the cache eviction scenario.
olivia (prod-commms): Closing thread after RCA. :wave:
